issues.title: Validate section records and page-batch helper compatibility
issues.goal: Make the supplied helper handle section-sized chunks inside uniquely owned physical-page batches without weakening source fidelity, and prove the contract using original synthetic fixtures only.
issues.worker_reason: Source interpretation, layout contracts and omission review require judgment.
inputs: AGENTS.md, contracts/CONTENT_RULES.md, contracts/RECORDS.md, contracts/DELIVERY.md
workflow/scripts/source_md.py and workflow/WORKFLOW.md; contracts/RECORDS.md (target additive schema)

Layout evidence: CS physical 008 has sections 1 and 2 on one image; CS 208/209 is a question/answer pair; textbooks can continue a section across issue boundaries. Inspect those designated layouts only; do not transcribe them.
outputs: Backward-compatible helper with check-manifest and check-batch subcommands plus batch-aware check/assemble
Synthetic tests and contracts/HELPER_COMPATIBILITY.md with schema/command behavior and evidence
acceptance: Retain legacy sources.json/tasks.json behavior. In batch mode validate each included physical image has exactly one batch owner, while multiple section chunks may cite different regions of that same batch image. Every chunk still represents one section or a bounded continuation.

Reject missing/duplicate pages, path escapes, changed hashes, out-of-batch chunk locators, unresolved markers, invalid statuses and contradictory repeated headings. Do not claim automatic checks prove semantic coverage.

Provide check-manifest PROJECT; check-batch PROJECT --batch ID; check PROJECT; assemble PROJECT, as specified in contracts/RECORDS.md. Reject assembly until every source/chapter review gate is passed.

Assembly removes YAML and only duplicated continuation boundary headings; preserve every other body byte and source order. Test a return to an earlier section ID and reject an out-of-order continuation.

Use synthetic fixtures only. No production ingestion, converted chapters, source-text examples, OCR, integration, cards, model switching or workers. If the additive record contract cannot preserve the workflow rules, leave this issue blocked and request an Astra planning revision.
verification: python3 -m unittest discover -s workflow/tests -v -> all focused legacy and batch-mode positive/negative fixtures pass
python3 workflow/scripts/source_md.py --help -> documented commands visible; synthetic assembly golden output matches expected bytes
git diff --check -> exit 0; review changes against workflow/WORKFLOW.md -> no weakened content rule
evidence: Test commands/exit codes and golden-output SHA-256; changed paths and saved main commit; remote readback
Explain separately physical-page batch ownership and section-level chunk provenance; record any rule conflict as BLOCKED, never silently relax it
